headline: Classic Carrom Physics & Bank-Shot AI in Vanilla JS
text:
Classic Carrom rebuilt in pure vanilla JS.

The AI calculates restitution-corrected cushion bank shots in real-time in your browser.

Zero installs, loads in 0.1s:
https://kreeda.games/carrom/index.html

#gamedev #webdev #indiedev
mediaSuggestion: A fast 6-second high-framerate video/GIF showing a smooth striker flick, an impossible cushion bank shot by the AI, and the red Queen sinking into the corner pocket with smooth physics.
